output_rule: Each target has model_1.pdb, inference.log, complete.json; completed records validated via SHA256 and PDB sanity checks.
limitations: Native reference structures have missing coordinates for some RNA residues; standardized mapping is required before scoring.
Checkpoint subcomponent hashes and peak GPU memory were not collected for this batch; model repository commit and per-target output hashes were recorded.
This is a 10-target pilot, not a finalized large-scale template-sparse comparison.
